mintAuthority.summary: Canonical Ethereum USDx is issued through USDxMarket signed-order settlement. A 3-of-5 Safe administers roles, routes and capacity directly; a separate two-day timelock owns the proxy upgrade path. The market operator cannot change the user's signed order, but collateral valuation and approval remain offchain.

controls.label: Axis USDxMarket canonical issuer
controls.capDescription: Signed orders must pass account eligibility, signer, enabled route/channel, nonce and configured CapConfig capacity checks. Exact current cap amounts and complete latent route closure are not asserted.

sources.label: USDxMarket signed-order settlement and capacity checks

controls.evidence: At block 26107703, USDx.hasRole(MARKET_ROLE, USDxMarket) returned true. Official documentation identifies the market as the live launch issuance route and documents cap-limited atomic settlement of user-signed orders. The market does not independently value collateral through an external price oracle. Future BRIDGE_ROLE assignment is an admin expansion surface, not an authored active bridge deployment.

controls.label: Axis published mint operator
controls.capDescription: Executes approved signed mint orders under USDxMarket capacity and routing constraints; exact cap values remain unreviewed.
controls.evidence: USDxMarket.hasRole(MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE, this published wallet) returned true at block 26107703. Docs call it KMS-secured; no independent HSM/MPC key-custody attestation or complete operator-role membership census was retrieved. The wallet executes settlement, while risk-increasing configuration remains with the governance Safe.

controls.label: Axis governance Safe native issuance administration

sources.label: Axis risk-up governance and role administration

controls.evidence: At block 26107703, getThreshold returned 3 and getOwners returned five addresses. Complete getModulesPaginated(0x1,20) returned an empty array with terminal sentinel 0x1, and the standard Safe guard slot was zero. USDx and MarketConfig.hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, Safe) returned true. Docs permit role grants and cap/route expansion without an enforced timelock; the separate upgrade delay does not constrain these admin actions. Signer independence and nonstandard bypass closure are not established.

controls.label: Axis native USDx proxy-upgrade timelock

sources.label: Pinned proxy owner and minimum-delay observation

controls.evidence: The canonical token's EIP-1967 admin slot returned ProxyAdmin 0xde4552a601e0424bdf5407b2b465d63a3df6a271; its owner() returned this TimelockController. getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds at block 26107703. The implementation slot returned 0x7c4ba7477f180b0370338f722c3717b3fbfda1c6. A future implementation can change issuance semantics; complete proposer/executor membership and all bypass paths remain unresolved.

sources.label: Axis canonical V2 proxy and upgrade model

review.evidence: Reopened issuer documentation and pinned read-only Ethereum calls at block 26107703, hash 0x1af27eeae8f8788fa7897fa456addc58ffc0e2e5f01befe9a58256167e5aeb9d (22:43:59 UTC, October 2, 2026), confirm canonical supply 60,779,732.78107246 USDx, market mint authority, published operator membership, the 3-of-5 Safe and two-day ProxyAdmin owner timelock. Native risk-up configuration is not delayed. Accountable reserve reporting does not establish full issuance-ledger reconciliation or prudential supervision, so both economic facts remain unknown. Legacy Plasma V1 is a distinct instrument and is not included as another canonical deployment.
